Overall verdict: needs_changes. The target declaration and structured context match, and no forbidden command shapes were recorded. The prior CLI/documentation blockers are resolved and match the [official Buzz CLI contract](https://github.com/block/buzz/blob/main/crates/buzz-cli/README.md).

FINDING (medium, correctness): `notify_buzz.notify()` can raise instead of returning a boolean for a configured event with a whitespace-only body. Evidence: `_format_content()` indexes `event.body.strip().splitlines()[0]`; direct reproduction raised `IndexError`. Recommendation: safely handle an empty stripped body and add a regression test covering this fail-soft path.

FINDING (low, style): The changed Python files fail targeted Ruff validation with four fixable violations. Evidence: I001 in `notify_buzz.py` and `notify_event.py`, plus two UP037 violations in `notify_buzz.py`. Recommendation: organize imports and remove redundant quoted annotations.

FINDING (advisory, correctness): The implementer audit’s findings array falsely claims `Env: dev` was missing, despite it appearing in both the summary and structured context. Recommendation: remove the stale advisory when regenerating the audit record.
